answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lock-up rather than node count. Like a karst landscape carved by time, the network creates immutable structures that prevent low-cost identity duplication. An attacker attempting a Sybil strike must acquire majority stake, a process as arduous as crafting a sonnet under the pressure of a shifting economic zephyr. This high capital requirement renders the creation of countless fake identities fiscally irrational.
